description: This file contains shell script functions for managing and upgrading firmware on ASRock devices, including manipulating MTD partitions and setting upgrade flags.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies boot configuration in MTD partition depending on upgrade mode ('bootcheck' or 'sysupgrade').

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting flags and removing certain UBI volumes.
